[EN] Mission Orders

Eliminate the enemies in the Gallery of Deceit and the Gallery of Lust of Azarel's Labyrinth and bring proof of their deaths.

Operation Target: {@LinkCreature:9#600#undying fighters}, {@LinkCreature:9#430#gula gutslashers}, {@LinkCreature:9#700#Alizarin imp hunters}, {@LinkCreature:9#710#Alizarin imp warders}, {@LinkCreature:9#800#gula butchers}, and {@LinkCreature:9#900#caiman cooks}.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Elimina a los enemigos en la Gallery of Deceit y la Gallery of Lust de Azarel's Labyrinth y trae pruebas de su muerte.

Objetivo de la operación: {@LinkCreature:9#600#undying fighters}, {@LinkCreature:9#430#gula gutslashers}, {@LinkCreature:9#700#Alizarin imp hunters}, {@LinkCreature:9#710#Alizarin imp warders}, {@LinkCreature:9#800#gula butchers} y {@LinkCreature:9#900#caiman cooks}.

[EN] It's a reward from the federation. Blessings to all the members of the Guild!
[ES] Es una recompensa de la federación. ¡Bendiciones para todos los miembros del gremio!
